title: Manual automation not changing profile %
body:
I have an _activity_ manual automation. Sets profile to 30% and TT to 150.

The _set TT to 150_ is working but _set profile to 30%_ or 50% isn't working. 

![Screenshot_20250228_160057_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8da099df-b7ef-41f4-8212-ac59a60608a6)

![Screenshot_20250228_155638_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c04d6bfb-96ea-479a-822f-cbcf6505a90d)

![Screenshot_20250228_155941_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/be11a035-ce9f-4130-993b-8836f60ad15b)

Even without the TT, the profile % doesn't change.

Here are the logs. Look around 15h50 and later.

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1740754810300.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19029354/AndroidAPS_LOG_1740754810300.log.zip)

Using last dev

![Screenshot_20250226_201028_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ef8fb1c8-5342-4709-9ac7-236fefa78a15)

comments.body:
When I try to change profile % manually,  I get this strange message and the profile % doesn't change either.

![Screenshot_20250228_161020_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7d99febf-e7f9-443c-b3bd-a3026be80067)

The basal rate at the moment, 0.3U/h at 30% gives 0.09U/h which should be accepted by Medtrum. 50% doesn't work either (0.15U/h)

![Screenshot_20250228_161224_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1c835987-eb7f-4a5d-a494-42e62d243a00)
Manually, I cannot change **the profile %** but if I change the **profile AND the profile %**, then it works.
Very strange, it's working normally this morning...

I thought the limit for automations was 50% ;)

I can see a basal rate in your profile is 0,15. So 0,15 * 0,3 = 0,045 which is below the lowest basal rate that can be set on pump at the moment (?). I believe that is why you get this error message if you use that profile and try to execute automation rule.

As I said, I got the same error when changing profile to 50% too... It was something else but what ???

FYI, I changed the automation limits to 30 and 150% for my personal use.

I testes 50% on latest dev and no issues (virtual pump)
Test unmodified version
@MilosKozak As said this morning, all is back to normal and working normally as before. No idea what happened yesterday. Did you see anything strange in the logs ?
Hmmm no idea what happened. Pump was reporting profile already set correctly but AAPS didn't see it
